evidence.section: 3.1. Phase constitutions and microstructure of as-cast alloys
evidence.quote: With addition of Mn, some new phases begin to appear: Ti solid solution (Tiss) and Mn 2Ti phase is identiﬁed when the atomic ratio of Mn reaches 4 at.%.

evidence.section: 3.1. Phase constitutions and microstructure of as-cast alloys
evidence.quote: When atomic ratio of Mn reaches 8 at.%, a ﬁne eutectic structure appears between dendrites as shown in Fig. 3 (h'). Figure 6 shows the TEM image and map scanning of this eutectic region. Combining Fig. 6 , XRD analysis of phases constituent and previous research [ 25], the darker gray phase has a lot of Ti, it can be certain as Tiss phase. Figure 7 is SADPs of the black phase. Combing Fig. 6(e) and calculation result of interplanar spacing, the black phase is identiﬁed by Mn 2Ti phase.
Tiss and Mn 2Ti eutectic structure precipitates at the grain boundary

evidence.quote: a lot of black phases appears in heat-treatment alloys, as shown in Fig. 9(a)e(h). According to the analysis of the phase and composition, this black phase contains a lot of Ti. Combining with previous studies [ 25,26], this black phase could be identiﬁed as Tiss phase.

evidence.section: 3.3.1. Room-temperature fracture toughness of as-cast alloys
evidence.quote: When the atomic ratio of Mn reaches 4 at.%, the fracture toughness of the as-cast alloys get a peak (8.07 MPa m1/2).

evidence.section: 3.3.3. Room-temperature compressive properties of as-cast alloys
evidence.quote: as the atomic ratio of Mn in alloys increases from 0 at.% to 4 at.%, the compressive strength increases gradually with a degree of 15%.
K Q value of as-cast Nb e16Sie22Tie8Mn alloy has increased by 17% compared to as-cast Nbe16Sie22Ti alloy
heat-treatment 8Mn alloy has increased by 107% compared to heat-treatment Nbe16Sie22Ti alloy
This dissolution of Mn in Nbss phase and silicide causes solid solution strengthening.
Solid solution strengthening effect of Mn in Nbss contributes to the improvement of room-temperature fracture toughness greatly.
